dn4:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅgesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi yena campā tadavasari.
dn4:1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
dn4:1.4: tena kho pana samayena soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo campaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā māgadhena seniyena bimbisārena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
dn4:2.2: “samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito aṅgesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi campaṃ anuppatto, campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
dn4:2.3: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
dn4:2.4: “itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
dn4:2.5: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
dn4:2.6: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
dn4:2.7: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī”ti.
dn4:2.8: atha kho campeyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā campāya nikkhamitvā saṅghasaṅghī gaṇībhūtā yena gaggarā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkamanti.
dn4:3.1: tena kho pana samayena soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo uparipāsāde divāseyyaṃ upagato hoti.
dn4:3.2: addasā kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo campeyyake brāhmaṇagahapatike campāya nikkhamitvā saṅghasaṅghī gaṇībhūte yena gaggarā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkamante.
dn4:3.4: “kinnu kho bho khatte, campeyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā campāya nikkhamitvā saṅghasaṅghī gaṇībhūtā yena gaggarā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkamantī?”ti.
dn4:3.5: “atthi kho bho, samaṇo gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito aṅgesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi campaṃ anuppatto campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
dn4:3.6: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
dn4:3.7: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
dn4:3.9: tena hi bho khatte, yena campeyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tenupasaṅkama. upasaṅkamitvā campeyyake brāhmaṇagahapatike evaṃ vadehi:
dn4:3.11: ‘āgamentu kira bhavanto soṇadaṇḍo’pi brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī”ti.
dn4:3.12: ‘evaṃ bho’ti kho so khattā soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā yena campeyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā campeyyake brāhmaṇagahapatike etadavoca:
dn4:3.14: “āgamentu kira bhavanto, soṇadaṇḍo’pi brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī”ti.
dn4:4.1: tena kho pana samayena nānāverajjakānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ pañcamattāni brāhmaṇasatāni campāyaṃ paṭivasanti kenacideva karaṇīyena.
dn4:4.3: ‘soṇadaṇḍo kira brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī’ti.
dn4:4.4: atha kho te brāhmaṇā yena soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn4:4.5: ‘saccaṃ kira bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī’?”ti

dn4:5.4: yampi bhoto soṇadaṇḍassa yaso hāyissati samaṇassa gotamassa yaso abhivaḍḍhissati. iminā paṅgena na arahati bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.

dn4:7.1: atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo mahatā brāhmaṇagaṇena saddhiṃ yena gaggarā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkami.
dn4:8.1: atha kho soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa tirovanasaṇḍagatassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
dn4:8.2: “ahañceva kho pana samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pañhaṃ puccheyyaṃ,
dn4:8.3: tatra ce maṃ samaṇo gotamo evaṃ vadeyya:
dn4:8.4: ‘na kho esa brāhmaṇa pañho evaṃ pucchitabbo, evaṃ nāmesa brāhmaṇa pañho pucchitabbo’ti. tena maṃ ayaṃ parisā paribhaveyya:
dn4:8.5: ‘bālo soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo abyatto, nāsakkhi samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ yoniso pañhaṃ pucchitunti’.
dn4:8.6: yaṃ kho panāyaṃ parisā paribhaveyya, yaso’pi tassa hāyetha,
dn4:8.7: yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha bhogā’pi tassa hāyeyyuṃ.
dn4:8.9: mañceva kho pana samaṇo gotamo pañhaṃ puccheyya, tassa cāhaṃ pañhassa veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ na ārādheyyaṃ,
dn4:8.10: tatra ce maṃ samaṇo gotamo evaṃ vadeyya:
dn4:8.11: ‘na kho esa brāhmaṇa pañho evaṃ vyākātabbo. evaṃ nāmesa brāhmaṇa pañho vyākātabbo’ti, tena maṃ ayaṃ parisā paribhaveyya:
dn4:8.12: ‘bālo soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, abyatto nāsakkhi samaṇassa gotamassa pañhassa veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādhetunti.
dn4:8.13: yaṃ kho panāyaṃ parisā paribhaveyya, yaso’pi tassa hāyetha.
dn4:8.14: yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha bhogāpi tassa hāyeyyuṃ.
dn4:8.16: ahañceva kho pana evaṃ samīpagato samāno adisvā’va samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ nivatteyyaṃ, tena maṃ ayaṃ parisā paribhaveyya:
dn4:8.17: ‘bālo soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo abyatto mānatthaddho bhīto ca. no visahi samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ. kathaṃ hi nāma samīpagato samāno adisvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ nivattissatī?’ti.
dn4:8.18: yaṃ kho panāyaṃ parisā paribhaveyya yaso’pi tassa hāyetha.
dn4:8.19: yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha, bhogā’pi tassa hāyeyyuṃ,
dn4:9.1: atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
dn4:9.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.

dn4:10.11: ‘na kho esa brāhmaṇa, pañho evaṃ vyākātabbo, evaṃ nāmesa brāhmaṇa pañho vyākātabbo’ti, tena maṃ ayaṃ parisā paribhaveyya:
dn4:10.12: ‘bālo soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo abyatto, nāsakkhi samaṇassa gotamassa pañhassa veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādhetunti’.
dn4:10.13: yaṃ kho panāyaṃ parisā paribhaveyya yaso’pi tassa hāyetha.
dn4:10.14: yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha bhogāpi tassa hāyeyyuṃ.
dn4:10.16: aho vata maṃ samaṇo gotamo sake ācariyake tevijjake pañhaṃ puccheyya. addhāvatassāhaṃ cittaṃ ārādheyyaṃ pañhassa veyyākaraṇenā”ti.
dn4:11.1: atha kho bhagavato soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya etadahosi:
dn4:11.2: “vihaññati kho ayaṃ soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo sakena cittena.
dn4:11.3: yannūnāhaṃ soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sake ācariyake tevijjake pañhaṃ puccheyyanti.”
dn4:11.4: atha kho bhagavā soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca:
dn4:11.5: “katīhi pana brāhmaṇa aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññapenti
dn4:11.6: brāhmaṇo’smīti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā?”ti
dn4:12.2: yaṃ vata no ahosi icchitaṃ, yaṃ ākaṅkhitaṃ, yaṃ adhippetaṃ, yaṃ abhipatthitaṃ
dn4:12.3: ‘aho vata maṃ samaṇo gotamo sake ācariyake tevijjake pañhaṃ puccheyya, addhā vatassāhaṃ cittaṃ ārādheyyaṃ pañhassa veyyākaraṇenā’ti, tatra maṃ samaṇo gotamo sake ācariyake tevijjake pañhaṃ pucchati.
dn4:12.4: addhā vatassāhaṃ cittaṃ ārādhessāmi pañhassa veyyākaraṇenā’ti.
dn4:13.1: atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo abbhunnāmetvā kāyaṃ anuviloketvā parisaṃ bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn4:13.2: “pañcahi bho gotama, aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpenti
dn4:13.3: ‘brāhmaṇo’smīti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyya.
dn4:13.5: idha bho gotama, brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā, akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
dn4:13.6: ajjhāyako hoti mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo:
dn4:13.7: abhirūpo hoti dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato, brahmavaṇṇī brahmavaccasī akkhuddāvakāso dassanāya.
dn4:13.9: paṇḍito ca hoti medhāvī, paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ.
dn4:13.10: imehi kho bho gotama, pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpenti.
dn4:13.11: brāhmaṇo’smīti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyāti.
dn4:14.1: “imesaṃ pana brāhmaṇa pañcannaṃ aṅgānaṃ sakkā ekaṃ aṅgaṃ ṭhapetvā catūhi aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpetuṃ
dn4:14.2: brāhmaṇo’smīti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā?”ti
dn4:14.4: imesaṃ hi bho gotama, pañcannaṃ aṅgānaṃ vaṇṇaṃ ṭhapayāma.
dn4:14.6: yato kho bho gotama, brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā, akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
dn4:14.7: ajjhāyako ca hoti mantadharo, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.
dn4:14.8: sīlavā ca hoti vuddhasīlī vuddhasīlena samannāgato,
dn4:14.9: paṇḍito ca hoti medhāvī paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ.
dn4:14.10: imehi kho bho gotama, catūhaṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpenti
dn4:14.11: brāhmaṇo’smīti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya, na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā”ti.
dn4:15.1: “imesaṃ pana brāhmaṇa catunnaṃ aṅgānaṃ sakkā ekaṃ aṅgaṃ ṭhapayitvā tīhi aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpetuṃ
dn4:15.2: brāhmaṇo’smīti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā?”ti.
dn4:15.4: imesaṃ hi bho gotama, catunnaṃ aṅgānaṃ mante ṭhapayāma.
dn4:15.6: yato kho bho gotama, brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā, akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena,
dn4:15.7: sīlavā ca hoti vuddhasīlī vuddhasīlena samannāgato,
dn4:15.8: paṇḍito ca hoti medhāvī, paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ.
dn4:15.9: imehi kho bho gotama, tīhi aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpenti
dn4:15.10: brāhmaṇo’smīti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā”ti.
dn4:16.1: “imesaṃ pana brāhmaṇa, tiṇṇaṃ aṅgānaṃ sakkā ekaṃ aṅgaṃ ṭhapetvā dvīhaṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpetuṃ,
dn4:16.2: brāhmaṇosmīti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā?”ti.
dn4:16.4: imesaṃ hi bho gotama, tiṇṇaṃ aṅgānaṃ jātiṃ ṭhapayāma.
dn4:16.6: yato kho bho gotama brāhmaṇo sīlavā ca hoti vuddhasīlī vuddhasīlena samannāgato,
dn4:16.7: paṇḍito ca hoti medhāvī paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ.
dn4:16.8: imehi kho bho gotama, dvīhaṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpenti.
dn4:16.9: brāhmaṇo’smīti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā”ti.
dn4:17.1: evaṃ vutte te brāhmaṇā soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn4:17.2: “mā bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo evaṃ avaca. mā bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo evaṃ avaca.
dn4:17.3: apavadateva bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo vaṇṇaṃ, apavadati mante, apavadati jātiṃ. ekaṃsena bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇasseva gotamassa vādaṃ anupakkhandatī”ti.
dn4:18.1: atha kho bhagavā te brāhmaṇe etadavoca:
dn4:18.3: ‘appassuto ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, akalyāṇavākkaraṇo ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, duppañño ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, na ca pahoti soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane paṭimantetunti, tiṭṭhatu soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, tumhe mayā saddhiṃ mantavho.
dn4:18.4: sace pana tumhākaṃ brāhmaṇā evaṃ hoti:
dn4:18.5: “bahussuto ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, kalyāṇavākkaraṇo ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, paṇḍito ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, pahoti ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane paṭimantetunti’ tiṭṭhatha tumhe, soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo mayā saddhiṃ paṭimantetū”ti.
dn4:19.1: evaṃ vutte soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn4:19.2: “tiṭṭhatu bhavaṃ gotamo. tuṇhī bhavaṃ gotamo hotu. ahameva tesaṃ sahadhammena paṭivacanaṃ karissāmī”ti.
dn4:19.3: atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo te brāhmaṇe etadavoca:
dn4:19.4: “mā bhavanto evaṃ avacuttha, mā bhavanto evaṃ avacuttha:
dn4:19.5: ‘apavadateva bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo vaṇṇaṃ, apavadati mante, apavadati jātiṃ, ekaṃsena. bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇasseva gotamassa vādaṃ anupakkhandatī’ti.
dn4:19.6: nāhaṃ bho apavadāmi vaṇṇaṃ vā mante vā jātiṃ vā”ti.
dn4:20.1: tena kho pana samayena soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa bhāgineyyā aṅgako nāma māṇavako tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
dn4:20.2: atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo te brāhmaṇe etadavoca:
dn4:20.3: “passanti no bhonto imaṃ aṅgakaṃ māṇavakaṃ amhākaṃ bhāgineyyanti?”
dn4:20.5: “aṅgako kho bho māṇavako abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahmavaṇṇī brahmavaccasī akkhuddāvakāso dassanāya. nāssa imissaṃ parisāyaṃ samasamo atthi vaṇṇena, ṭhapetvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ.
dn4:20.6: aṅgako kho bho māṇavako ajjhāyako mantadharo, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ. padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.
dn4:20.8: aṅgako kho bho māṇavako ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā, akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
dn4:20.10: aṅgako kho bho māṇavako pāṇampi haneyya adinnampi ādiyeyya paradārampi gaccheyya musāpi bhaṇeyya majjampi piveyya, etthadāni bho kiṃ vaṇṇo karissati, kiṃ mantā, kiṃ jāti?
dn4:20.11: yato kho bho brāhmaṇo sīlavā ca hoti vuddhasīlī vuddhasīlena samannāgato,
dn4:20.12: paṇḍito ca hoti medhāvī paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ.
dn4:20.13: imehi kho bho dvīhaṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpenti.
dn4:20.14: brāhmaṇo’smīti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya, na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā”ti.
dn4:21.1: “imesaṃ pana brāhmaṇa, dvinnaṃ aṅgānaṃ sakkā ekaṃ aṅgaṃ ṭhapayitvā ekena aṅgena samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpetuṃ,
dn4:21.2: brāhmaṇo’smīti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya. na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā?”ti
dn4:21.4: sīlaparidhotā hi bho gotama paññā. paññāparidhotaṃ sīlaṃ.
dn4:21.5: yattha sīlaṃ tattha paññā, yattha paññā tattha sīlaṃ.
dn4:21.8: seyyathāpi bho gotama hatthena vā hatthaṃ dhoveyya, pādena vā pādaṃ dhoveyya,
dn4:21.9: evameva kho bho gotama sīlaparidhotā paññā, paññāparidhotaṃ sīlaṃ.
dn4:21.10: yattha sīlaṃ tattha paññā, yattha paññā tattha sīlaṃ.
dn4:22.7: yattha sīlaṃ tattha paññā, yattha paññā tattha sīlaṃ.
dn4:22.13: sādhu vata bhavantaṃyeva gotamaṃ paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho”ti.
dn4:23.1: “tena hi brāhmaṇa suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmī”ti.
dn4:23.2: “evaṃ bho’ti kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
dn4:23.4: “idha brāhmaṇa, tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho …pe…. (yathā sāmaññaphale evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)
dn4:23.5: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti.
dn4:23.11: ayaṃ kho so brāhmaṇa samādhi …pe… āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati, abhininnāmeti …pe…
dn4:24.1: evaṃ vutte soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn4:24.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti, evameva bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
dn4:24.4: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
dn4:24.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gataṃ.
dn4:24.6: adhivāsetu ca me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
dn4:24.8: atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
dn4:24.9: atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi:
dn4:25.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
dn4:25.2: atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
dn4:26.1: atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn4:26.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn4:26.3: “ahañceva kho pana bho gotama, parisagato samāno āsanā vuṭṭhahitvā bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ abhivādeyyaṃ, tena maṃ sā parisā paribhaveyya.
dn4:26.4: yaṃ kho pana sā parisā paribhaveyya yaso’pi tassa hāyetha.
dn4:26.5: yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha bhogāpi tassa hāyeyyuṃ.
dn4:26.7: ahañceva kho pana bho gotama, parisagato samāno añjaliṃ paggaṇheyyaṃ, āsanā me taṃ bhavaṃ gotamo paccuṭṭhānaṃ dhāretu.
dn4:26.8: ahañceva kho pana bho gotama, parisagato samāno veṭhanaṃ omuñceyyaṃ, sirasā me taṃ bhavaṃ gotamo abhivādanaṃ dhāretu.
dn4:26.9: ahañceva kho pana bho gotama, yānagato samāno yānā paccorohitvā bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ abhivādeyyaṃ, tena maṃ sā parisā paribhaveyya.
dn4:26.10: yaṃ kho pana sā parisā paribhaveyya yaso’pi tassa hāyetha. yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha bhogāpi tassa hāyeyyuṃ.
dn4:26.12: ahañceva kho pana bho gotama, yānagato samāno patodalaṭṭhiṃ abbhunnāmeyyaṃ, yānā me taṃ bhavaṃ gotamo paccorohanaṃ dhāretu.
dn4:26.13: ahañceva kho pana bho gotama, yānagato samāno chattaṃ apanāmeyyaṃ, sirasā me taṃ bhavaṃ gotamo abhivādanaṃ dhāretū”ti.
dn4:27.1: atha kho bhagavā soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmīti.
